name: @eleven-am/notifier
description: Type-safe state management for React with class-based architecture, selectors, and event handling

scripts.build:check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:ci
scripts.prepublish:copy: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); p.main='index.js'; p.types='index.d.ts'; delete p.scripts; delete p.devDependencies; require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify(p, null, 2));" && cp README.md dist/ && cp LICENSE dist/
scripts.release: npm run build:check && npm run build && npm run prepublish:copy
scripts.release:patch: npm run release && npm run version:patch && npm run prepublish:copy && npm run publish:npm
scripts.release:minor: npm run release && npm run version:minor && npm run prepublish:copy && npm run publish:npm
scripts.release:major: npm run release && npm run version:major && npm run prepublish:copy && npm run publish:npm

author: Roy OSSAI
